column3: Nami's story starts with a deal. When she was ten, the pirate Arlong killed her adoptive mother, and took over her village.
So Nami made him an offer. She would work for him, and buy the village back, for one hundred million berries.
For eight years, she stole, saved, and carried it alone. She told her sister she would fight by herself, because asking anyone for help would get people killed.
She was seven million short, when Arlong had a corrupt Marine take all of it.
In episode thirty seven, everything she'd held together breaks. In despair, she turns on the tattoo that marks her as one of his crew. Until Luffy catches her arm.
She yells at him. Tells him he doesn't know anything. He stays.
And then, for the first time in eight years, she says it. Luffy. Help me.
He puts his treasured straw hat on her head, walks a few steps, and shouts that of course he will.
Zoro, Usopp and Sanji are already waiting. And the four of them walk to Arlong Park.
